test_MigrationAddDatasetStatusToQueueMet: test the MigrationAddDatasetStatusToQueueMetrics migration to add dataset_status field to queue metrics
run_migration_up: run the migration up method to add dataset_status field with default value normal to existing queue metrics documents
run_migration_down: run the migration down method to remove the dataset_status field from all queue metrics documents
validate_migration: validate the migration by checking a random sample of queue metrics documents have the dataset_status field
build_migration_class: build a MongoDB migration class extending Migration with up, down, and validate methods for schema changes
